name: Early Years
summary: Play, stories, songs, mud, and a lot of talking. We follow the British EYFS framework and speak English all day. Half days are fine for the littlest ones.

name: Primary
summary: Cambridge English, Maths, and Science in the morning. PE every day. Afternoons rotate through vocational classes like cooking, art, and technology.

name: Secondary
summary: Cambridge Lower Secondary in the core subjects, taught by subject specialists. Same daily PE and vocational rotation, with more independence and bigger projects.

name: Upper Years
summary: A US diploma or a Cambridge pathway, at your own pace, with a coach in the room. Plus IELTS, PTE, and GED prep, a personal project, and one trip a year that the students plan themselves.

name: Global Program
summary: For families passing through. Your child joins a real class, not a holiday club. Choose a half day or full day, academic or hands-on, and leave with a report and a certificate.
points: Progress report in the first two weeks
